tallBackground:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: BACKGROUND ONLY for a tall interior vertical platforming room. Reference supplies art direction only. Portrait canvas, target 1024x1152 aspect 8:9.
A single grand vertical pale limestone atrium, orthographic flat SIDE VIEW. Very tall continuous rear piers at left and right, with arch capitals and one generous arch head ONLY NEAR THE TOP. The vertical center opens onto pale blue sky, muted hills and distant tiny cream village roofs visible LOW in the scene, so climbing upward naturally reveals more sky. Left edge includes quiet plaster wall and a pair of small narrow windows at different heights; right side quiet rear wall, not a copied column-door repeated everywhere. All main piers extend continuously from bottom to arch, absolutely no repeated storey arches or fake horizontal floors in the middle of the shaft.
NO foreground, NO platforms, NO stairs, NO solid terrain, NO walkable floor strip, NO character, props, UI, labels or borders. No depth floor plane. Whole canvas is decorative background behind a large traversable shaft.
Hand-painted clean 2D indie-game limestone detail, subtle broad facets, restrained chips; warm pale cream wall shapes, low local contrast, NO BLACK OUTLINES, no white walkable cap. Distant scenery lighter and simpler, no outlines. Clean even daylight. Crisp intentional architecture at background contrast, NOT blurred, no fog/rain/haze/paper grain, no luminous beams. Maintain source style without reproducing its gameplay foreground.
